svg.title: Proof. (1) is as stated; it applies (LCN3) to the two-point measure. (2) Recover the line series at radius q/4 by Lemma 14.27. Polarization makes the degree-n coefficient a symmetric multilinear map: the finite-difference formula divides by n!, has 2n summands and each sum of n unit vectors has norm at most n; nn/n! ≤en gives (LCN5). For increments z, z′ of norm at most 1/4 telescoping each diagonal gives X
